enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +14: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
